mentions.story: Nassim Taleb: Bitcoin failed as a currency and became a speculative ponzi scheme
mentions.quote: >"Money only works because we all agree to believe in it." Not only that, but it's a derivative (or perceived derivative!) of an underlying value, which in turn can be another derivative! A long time ago, that was Gold, which in turn is a derivative of food and everything else…
